about_title: Take Control of Your Digital Life
about_subtitle: The next-generation open-source security engine built by an independent developer and AI.
about_p1: DewSecure was born from a simple vision: to return control of the internet to the user. We believe you should decide what content you see, not advertisers and pervasive trackers.
about_p2: This is more than an interception tool; it's a privacy sandbox deeply integrating device-side AI and cloud federated learning. With 110,000+ precise rules and a 3-class AI model dual-engine, we purify your network environment in milliseconds.
about_p3: As a fully open-source software (Open Core), DewSecure's core engine code is open to scrutiny by global developers. We refuse to sell user data or engage in black-box operations.
trans_home_desc: The web is dynamic and tracking technologies keep evolving, so we cannot guarantee a 100% block rate. However, DewSecure evolves continuously through AI to provide you with the strongest filtering experience possible.
trans_about_p1: 1. Technical & Platform Limitations: We cannot achieve a 100% interception rate across all platforms.
trans_about_p2: 2. Dynamic Web Environment: We cannot guarantee that the tool will permanently block all future evasion techniques.
trans_about_p3: 3. Commitment to Continuous Evolution: Our AI models iterate automatically every week.

faq_1_q: What is the core difference between Free and Pro?
faq_1_a: Free provides full DNR rule blocking and anti-tracking features. Pro unlocks AI model cloud OTA updates, local on-device AI detection (anti-phishing/anti-mining), and cross-device cloud sync for whitelists.
faq_2_q: What happens after the trial ends? Will I be charged automatically?
faq_2_a: No. You get a 30-day Pro trial upon registration without auto-billing. You must manually subscribe via the pricing page. If you don't, the system automatically downgrades you to Free.
faq_3_q: What payment methods are supported? Is it secure?
faq_3_a: All payments are processed by Stripe. We support Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We never store your credit card info.
faq_4_q: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faq_4_a: Yes. We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied within 14 days of purchase, contact support for a full refund.
faq_5_q: Will I lose Pro features immediately if I cancel?
faq_5_a: No. Your benefits remain active until the end of your current billing cycle. After that, you will be downgraded to Free automatically without any hidden charges.
faq_6_q: Should I choose Pro or Family?
faq_6_a: Pro is for individuals (up to 3 devices like PC + Phone + Tablet). Family is for sharing with up to 9 devices. You can invite family members via email in the Dashboard.
faq_7_q: Do invited family members need to pay?
faq_7_a: No. Sub-accounts share the main account's subscription and expiry date. If the main account cancels or expires, all sub-accounts will also be downgraded to Free.
faq_8_q: Can I leave the family group or change members?
faq_8_a: Absolutely. The main account can remove members or unbind devices anytime in the Dashboard. Removed members immediately downgrade to Free.
faq_9_q: How does the 'Invite friends for 120 days Pro' reward work?
faq_9_a: When a friend registers via your link and completes their first real payment, after a 14-day cooling-off period (anti-fraud), 120 days of Pro will be automatically added to your account.
faq_10_a: Yes! Anyone can download and use it for free. If you register and log in, you get a free 30-day Pro trial.
faq_11_a: Absolutely not. DewSecure uses an Open Core model audited globally. All matching and AI inference happen locally. We never collect your browsing history or upload URLs.
faq_12_q: Why can't some YouTube ads be blocked?
faq_12_a: DewSecure respects the YouTube creator ecosystem. We do not block creator-revenue ads by default.
faq_13_a: Chrome and Edge on the same PC count as 2 devices. Android + PC count as 2 devices. You can unbind old devices in the Dashboard to free up slots.
faq_14_a: Some sites integrate ads deeply with content (same-origin). Blocking them breaks the layout. We prioritize usability. Also, our AI models update weekly to kill new ads.
faq_15_a: Yes, strong blocking is on by default. Tip: If a legitimate pop-up is blocked (like a login window), add the domain to your Whitelist in the extension panel.
faq_16_a: Yes. It's called 'Malvertising'. Hackers buy ad slots to spread trojans. DewSecure cuts off requests to these malicious networks at the root.
faq_17_q: Can DewSecure stop websites from stealing my CPU for crypto mining?
faq_17_a: Yes, very effectively. Pro uses on-device AI to detect and block silent mining scripts, saving your CPU and battery.
